title: Thicker cloth, less face per volume
hook: Which sheet has less face area per material volume?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Doubling thickness at the same width and length doubles material volume while keeping the two large face areas fixed. The area-to-volume ratio therefore halves.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.

recall.question: A 50 × 100 cm cloth goes from 2 mm to 4 mm thick. What happens to its face-area-to-volume ratio?
recall.why: The two large faces stay 50 × 100 cm each while the volume doubles with thickness, so the ratio halves. The ratio alone does not set a drying time.
